title.narrative: Output 1.4. Increased capacity of Member States to improve social dialogue and labour relations laws, processes and institutions

description.narrative: An action plan was adopted by the Department of Labour, which proposed the transfer of the labour dispute resolution function from the Department for Inspection of Factories into its operations. This organizational restructuring has now been included as a proposed amendment to the Bangladesh Labour Act. ILO conducted a diagnostic assessment of the non-judicial labour dispute resolution system in Bangladesh which produced the action plan that proposed the transfer of the labour dispute resolution function from the Department for Inspection of Factories to the Department of Labour. The ILO also facilitated the workshop comprising labour officers responsible for the conciliation of labour disputes, using the diagnostic tool for self-assessing the effectiveness of labour dispute prevention and resolution. This workshop developed the capacity of the labour officers.

description.narrative: The ILO’s Results Framework is always part of the Programme and Budget (P&B) document for the relevant biennium. Please refer to the Annex “Results Framework” of the relevant P&B Document

The ILO’s biennial Programme Implementation Report is an instrument of accountability. It describes the performance of the Organization against the commitments made in the Programme and Budget documents for the corresponding biennial period.
